target_audience: Indie filmmakers, animators, and directors tired of cloud slot machines and generic AI slop
core_feeling: Empowered that real, repeatable cinema can be directed locally without subscription fees
call_to_action: Join the Tuesday Cinema Club and clone the local starter kit
key_message: All the tools - Ollama, Blender, ComfyUI, Whisper, Kdenlive, and OpenTimelineIO - run locally for free, replace an $840-year Adobe plan, require no coding, and each agent does one job with a human approving every gate.
exclusions: No artificial AI hype jargon or hallucinated promises
No unverified claims without human approval
references: Opening cut mirrors the rapid montage style of 'Run Lola Run'
Color grading nods to the pastel palette of Wes Anderson's 'The Grand Budapest Hotel'
Soundscape references the ambient tones of Brian Eno's 'Music for Airports'
